info.title: accessibility service
info.description:
The core calculation: transit times (RAPTOR), car times (OSRM), ratio per H3 cell, with a
cache keyed by (feed version, origin cell, date, time, window, algorithm version).
Owns schema `accessibility`. No personal data: the origin is kept only as an H3
resolution-10 cell and the requesting user is not stored.

`x-access`: access level at the gateway (`internal` = not routed). `x-rate-limit`: per-minute
limit at the gateway (`anonymousPerMinute` applies to requests without a token).

forwards it; every service logs it, returns it and passes it on.

post.summary: Request an accessibility map for an origin
post.description:
Snaps the origin to its H3 resolution-10 cell and looks up the cache. A cached map is
returned with `200`; otherwise the map is computed now (`201`). If the same question is
being computed by another request, `202` points to it. Signed-in requests are added to
the user's history through `accessibility.calculation.completed.v1`.

get.summary: Per-cell travel times, ratio and legend class
get.description: A finished calculation never changes, so the response is cacheable forever (until it expires and is removed).

transitS.description: Door-to-door seconds by public transport or on foot; null = not reachable.

carS.description: Driving seconds; null = no road route.

ratio.description: transitS / carS rounded to 2 decimals; null when either is null.
